articleTitle: An Electromagnetic MEMS Actuator for Micropumps
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper, design, fabrication and evaluation of an electromagnetic MEMS micropump actuator are reported. Based on MEMS technology, the proposed micropump actuator is designed and fabricated using integrated surface and bulk micromachining at the Microfabrication Facility at the Rochester Institute of Technology. A thin silicon diaphragm with a planar spiral coil ensures the desired degree of robustness and guarantees the specified volumetric changes. The magnetic force is generated due to the interaction between the magnetic field of a permanent magnet and current in the coil. The experimental results are reported

articleTitle: Measurement Methods for Yarn Hairiness Analysis - the idea and construction of research standing
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The paper presents a review of the most important measurement methods applied to determination of yarn attributes and a project of new automatic computer method of yarn image processing and analysis. The yarn feature that we examined is hairiness because of its importance for textile industry. Proposed construction of standing for automated computer analysis of yarn hairiness is new and alternative to the ones currently applied in industry, the most popular of which are: Uster tester 3 and Shirley's apparatus

articleTitle: Computer-Aided System for MEMS Design "ProMIP"
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper system for microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) end-to-end design is proposed. Such system includes: subsystem for modeling of manufacturing process flows of integrated circuits and MEMS - "ProMIS-T"; subsystem for solid modeling (ProMIP-Tv), functional (ProMIP-F) and system modeling (ProMIP-S)

articleTitle: Singular value decomposition for texture defect detection in visual inspection systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the authors propose an algorithm for texture defects detection, which doesn't use supervised classification. The algorithm can be simply applied in an automatic visual inspection system. For localization of texture defects features calculation of each non-overlapping region of an image via the singular value decomposition (SVD) and image processing techniques. In next step the algorithm uses the fuzzy c-means clustering (FCM) to classify each region into two clusters. Finally the authors define a distance between centres of defective and non-defective clusters using some threshold value chosen empirically

articleTitle: An Overview of MEMS Testing Technologies
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper is to concentrate on the methods of MEMS devices modeling and testing. This problem is urgent due to a MEMS device's miniaturized scales and high quality constraints. In the case of insufficient models of MEMS devices, a low quality product is supposed to be fabricated, resulting in necessity to be reconstructed and, thus, longer time and greater costs of production. As it has been made transparent, advanced CAD and mechanical tools are needed to enable testing of a MEMS device on all the stages of its production, from material usage and right till environmental effects upon the work of the device constructed. As an example, the fabrication of a bandpass filter will be considered. Each stage of the process will involve yet another type of testing and simulation. In the second part of the paper the main stages of the filter design will be considered, including the approaches to optimization striving towards specifications maximal match

articleTitle: Model of Capacitive Microaccelerometer
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Model of capacitive accelerometer is designed. Designed model allow to measure top- and bottom-side capacities. Presented modeling results as capacity and construction strain dependencies from the acceleration

articleTitle: CISC vs. RISC Hardware and Programming Complexity Measures of Addressing Modes
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The article is on the problem of evaluation of specific substructures in computer-based systems. The evaluation scheme utilizes an existing evaluation procedure of already implemented measures. These measures have been applied to determine the complexity measures of algorithmic devices. Two major aspects of address and data have been involved in the evaluation procedure. These two aspects are compared in their specifications with respect to different architectures CISC and RISC

articleTitle: Features of microelectromechanical systems design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this article author consider features or design and structure of microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) and propose to embed an algorithmic aspect. Usage of upward, downward and parallel MEMS design with algorithms on each of hierarchical levels are proposed

articleTitle: The Comparative Analysis of Automatic Trace Routing in PCAD and OrCAD
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The results of efficiency analysis for track automatic routing in PCAD and OrCAD software are considered. Such systems can be applied for design of devices which are used in microelectronic mechanical systems (MEMS)

articleTitle: Applicability of Triaxial Accelerometer for Energy Expenditure Calculation in Weight Lifting
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Energy expenditure is an important factor in evaluation of physical activity. The applicability of accelerometer in evaluation of energy expenditure in weight lifting was studied. A sensitive triaxial accelerometer was integrated to a wristwatch. The wristwatch was worn by 10 weight lift trainees during their exercise in different kinds of weight lifting sets. After the exercise the sensor data was analyzed. Statistical analysis of the data showed that the accuracy of calculation of repetitions in lifting sets was 5-11% and the variation in estimation of heights of lifts 14-32%. Due to the results the accelerometers seems to be applicable for energy expenditure estimation in weight lifting.

articleTitle: Game Methods of the Stochastic Boundary Problem Solution
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The game problems solution methods which are described by systems of the stochastic equations in partial derivative are investigated. The offered methods are based on an estimation of the characteristics of distributions of random quantities, which is carried out with the help self-learning of recurrent methods

articleTitle: Unified Matrix Processor Design for FCT-IV and FST-IV Hartley Based Transforms
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: A new unified fast shifted cosine and sine transform matrix processor based on fast Hartley transform is presented and described. It is also shown that the decimation-in-frequency (DIF) FCT-IV and FST-IV can be computed using the same building blocks which are used for computing decimation-in-time FCT-IV and FST-IV. A unified fast shifted cosine and sine transform matrix processor can be designed to compute either the DCT-IV or DST-IV

Author Keywords: Hartley Transform and FCT-IV and FST-IV algorithms

articleTitle: Three-dimensional model of flooding of the river floodplain - visualization of ecohydrological interactions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Ecohydrology is a scientific concept which suggests that the sustainable development of water resources has been dependent on the ability to maintain the ecosystem processes that have been established by evolution. These ecosystem processes regulate water and nutrient circulation and energy flow at the basin scale in two ways: biota are regulated by hydrology and hydrology is regulated by biota (Zalewski, 2000) (Zalewski, 2002). The simulation of hydrological processes allows us better managing of natural environment and industrial resources. Visualization of numerical results of these processes in 3D world is an original and new approach. Mathematical and graphical modules are separate each other, what makes the application practicable and in the future allowed use this model to another resolves

articleTitle: Application Of The Edge-Based Image Segmentation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper computerized system fcr high temperature measurements of superficial properties has been presented. The process of superficial properties determination is based on digital image processing and analysis algorithms. Image segmentation methods in aforementioned system have been discussed. Particular attention has been paid to new approach for edge-based image segmentation involving parallel performance of gradient operator and thresholding mechanism

articleTitle: Analogue Globally Stable WTA Neural Circuit
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: A new inhibitory analogue WTA (winner-take-all) neural circuit which identifies maximal among N unknown input signals is proposed. As a building block the second order analogue globally stable neural network of Hopfield type is used. The connection matrix belongs to the class of diagonally stable block diagonal matrices and the activation functions are piecewise linear or sigmoid. The mathematical justification of the circuit functioning, comparative evaluation with analogs and computer simulation results are given

articleTitle: Digital image processing methods in biological structure recognition - a short review
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper presents general methods of biological images processing. These techniques are oriented to better image interpretation. Many biological structures are difficult to recognize in the picture due to deficient light conditions, particle aggregations or erroneous similarity to other objects. We made the illustration of the function and result of few methods, adapted to image recognition and identification. The results of image preprocessing are presented based on real biological structure examples

articleTitle: Image fusion for dual tomography
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The many methodologies that exist for monitoring and investigation of flows in industrial applications were recently reviewed in current literature. In this paper we present image fusion algorithms for dual tomography based on several modalities against well-known methods, which use one modality. These two modalities are complimentary both for spatial and temporal resolutions

articleTitle: Selected segmentation methods applied for DNA image cytometry
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper presents new algorithm of plant nuclei segmentation for the purpose of DNA contents measurements. This algorithm is based on preliminary discrimination of nuclei objects in RGB colour space and then on local applying of some global thresholding methods in a rectangular ROI area. Segmented nuclei objects are zoomed more than in typical applications to improve quantitative analysis

articleTitle: Subsystem Development on the Functional Level of MEMS Design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper, a subsystem development on the functional level of MEMS design is considered

articleTitle: Underwater Robot Actuated by Shape Memory Alloy Wires
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The main goal of this paper is to provide design of an underwater robot with actuators utilizing advanced and smart materials such as Shape Memory Alloys (SMA).

articleTitle: Valuing Reliability Indices of Composite Embedded Systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: A method of investigation of reliability parameters of compound systems by means of generating functions is developed taking account of aging of the system's output elements. Main reliability indices of composite embedded systems are examined in this paper

articleTitle: Application Of The Embedded Analysisng Systems For The Detection Of Dangerous Substances
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper deals with the design expedience of the embedded systems with chemical sensors. The functioning principles of chemical sensors have been considered. The scheme of the device for the detection of the required chemical components in the environment has been suggested, and the choice of the chemical sensors types that may be used in such device has been grounded

articleTitle: A novel computational approach to detect isolated and continuous phase in structured materials
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper, a novel simple algorithm based on geometrical considerations is proposed to identify and classify in three-dimensional images phases which are interconnected or isolated. The approach is tested on two types of materials - composite reinforced with different fractions of spherical ceramic particles and nuclear graphite with different contents of porosity. The fraction of continuous phase are in good agreement with percolation threshold, which validates the approach

articleTitle: Continuation of Developing an Electrokinetic Phenomena Model in VHDL-AMS Language
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the continuation of developing electro-kinetic phenomena models in VHDL-AMS language is presented. At the beginning the origin of the project is presented, than the model assumptions are introduced and discussed. A short derivation of models' equations is also given, and finally simulation results are demonstrated and discussed

articleTitle: Fast Cosine Transform Algorithm on Base Cyclic Convolutions
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: An efficient discrete cosine transform algorithm is introduced. The discrete basis matrix are presented of cyclic sections. This algorithm uses cyclic convolutions for computation discrete cosine transform

articleTitle: MBS signal dedicated to the identification of dynamic properties of electric resistance furnaces
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper an advantage of MBS signal dedicated to identification of dynamic properties of electric resistance furnace is presented. The utility of generated signal for the identification of electric resistance furnace was verified in the full range of angular frequencies by the computer simulation

articleTitle: Operational Amplifiers Design with Application of DUET Electro-thermal Simulator
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the work on the analogue components library in CMOS 0.35 mum technology is presented. First part consists of a few operational amplifiers (opamp) with different parameters. The electro-thermal simulator was used in this project, which allows to shape a frequency response of the opamps in various cooling conditions. Second part shows research that verifies proper operation of the DUET simulator and motivate its usefulness during presented projects

articleTitle: Problems of Creation of Intelligent Computer Tools for Engineering Design
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The paper deals with the problems of building CAD systems using the methodology of problem adaptation. It is shown the method of creation of adaptors - artificial intelligent program components - using the paradigm of objective-oriented programming. Also it is discussed some common scientific aspects of building intelligent objects and the development of intelligent information environments on the platform of agent technologies

articleTitle: Rf-Mems Components In Mobile Communication Terminal
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Micro-machined passive components open new perspectives to the integration of multi-standard RF transceivers for mobile communications. The different types of components are reviewed and their potential use in transceiver architectures is outlined

articleTitle: System For Physical Processes Simulation In Hydraulic Microelectromechanical Systems
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In the article problems of program-methodical system development for physical processes analysis in hydro-and gas dynamic systems are considered

articleTitle: Petri Networks Application during MEMS Design Process
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: This paper is to define the peculiarities of Petri networks application on the system level of MEMS design

articleTitle: Automated calculation of piezoresistive microsensors by CAD/CAM/CAE
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: The control program is developed for conducting of the automated calculation of piezoresistive microsensors type for measuring of pressure by the API functions of CAD/CAM/CAE. Research of influencing of geometrical parameters and pressure is conducted on initial descriptions of sensor

articleTitle: Developing the Structure of the Experimental MEFS
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper results obtained during multidomain simulations of MEFS structure are presented. Simulations were prepared and performed as a part of scientific effort, which was put while designing and developing the first Polish MEFS system. The structure should fulfil several requirements, among which structure simplicity and short separation time are the most crucial ones. Simulations allowed to predict that the structure is incapable to separate two compounds, which have similar electrophoretic mobilities

articleTitle: MOEMS With Thin-Film Crystals
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper we examine high-performance micro-opto-electro-mechanical systems (MOEMS). The studied MOEMS composed from optoelectromagnetic active high-refractive index thin-film crystals, radiating energy devices (antenna), variable-wavelength vertical cavity surface emitting laser (VCSEL), and driving/controlling integrated circuits (ICs). In order to steer and accurately position a beam, we vary the high-frequency electric filed and light wavelength. Experimental, applied and fundamental results are reported.

articleTitle: Perspectives of using embedded systems of microelectronics and micromechanics in the applied tasks of moving objects navigation
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the comparison of angular velocity and acceleration sensors built on traditional gyro constructional principles and iMEMS technologies is presented. It is shown that devices built on iMEMS technologies have some wider application perspectives due to their operational and economic advantages

articleTitle: Optimization of the Radiating Performances for the High-Frequency Devices Used in the MEMS Applications
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Two types of antennas, which are used as the radiating devices in the microwave technique, are examined. The amplitude radiation characteristics of antennas are optimized in a wide frequency band. These characteristics are obtained by means of statement and solution of the appropriate synthesis problems. The variational statement of problems allows to take into account the requirements to the amplitude radiation pattern and front-to-rear factor in the operating frequency band as well as outside of this band. The methods of successive approximations are applied for solving the received nonlinear integral equations, as well as the direct optimization of the used functional is carried out. The results of numerical modeling are shown

articleTitle: Problems of synchronization of the PCI devices for the embedded systems in the real time
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: In this paper the bus of PCI was developed for application in the personal computers. However lately the bus of PCI in one or another form all more frequent finds application in the embedded systems. Different methods allowing to make multitreatment in the real time with the use of the so-called bridges of PCI-PCI are presently used (PPB). It is needed expressly to differentiate the devices with symmetric and asymmetric multitreatment. At asymmetric multitreatment a few PCI-cards associate through the bus of PCI. Each such card is "intellectual", it has the own processor. Base configuration realized a user interface and network part of the system on the basis of main processor with the additional modules of input/output, providing treatment in the real time

articleTitle: Parametric Modelling Algorithms in Electrical Capacitance Tomography for Multiphase Flow Monitoring
publicationTitle: Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Perspective Technologies and Methods in MEMS Design
abstract: Bayesian statistics is a powerful physical phenomena modelling tool. However it usually demands highly iterative algorithms, hence it is was not widely used so far. Recently, rapid development of computing capabilities enables use of such methods. Computing methodology here presented features Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods applied to Bayesian modelling. The essential aspect is enabling direct characteristic parameters estimation, hence omitting the phase of image reconstruction widely produced whenever process tomography is applied. This property has an important feature of making feasible implementation of automatic industrial process control systems based on electrical capacitance tomography (ECT)
